Claim: Germany processes significantly more freight and parcels than comparable European economies
Result: Germany was Europe's freight giant for two decades but Poland has quietly overtaken it in recent years. On parcels however Germany is in a different league entirely processing over 3x more per person than France and the gap is still growing

Claim: Germany's transport sector contributes disproportionately to GHG emissions relative to its EU peers
Result: Germany's transport sector emits more than any other country in our comparison. Nearly 25% more than France despite similar population size

Claim: The gap between Germany's logistics environmental impact and its mitigation efforts is larger than its green image suggests
Result: Emissions dropped 20% over two decades which is progress but recycling grew less than 9% in the same period. The green reputation is ahead of the green reality
